name: Snoozlet

abilities.name: Power Nap
abilities.description: Restores a little HP whenever it stays still for a turn.

abilities.name: Comfy Den
abilities.description: Cannot be woken by sound-based moves.

entry: It frequently falls asleep throughout the day, often mid-sentence. Its soft fur keeps it warm through the coldest Winterveil nights.

artwork.alt: Snoozlet curled up in a nightcap

name: Dozemore

abilities.name: Eyes Open
abilities.description: Appears fully alert while asleep. Opponents' moves are less likely to land a critical hit.

abilities.name: Comfy Den
abilities.description: Cannot be woken by sound-based moves.

entry: It can appear fully awake while sleeping soundly. If accused of dozing, it will calmly insist it was only resting its eyes.

artwork.alt: Dozemore sitting upright with half-closed eyes

name: Napnarch

abilities.name: Midnight Reign
abilities.description: Raises Special Attack after midnight. Never admits it is tired.

abilities.name: Dream Crown
abilities.description: Moves used while asleep cannot miss.

entry: It rules the hours after midnight and insists an early bedtime is impossible. Its crown glows brighter the later it stays up.

artwork.alt: Napnarch wearing a crescent moon crown

name: Humbleat

abilities.name: Wind Melody
abilities.description: Speed rises in windy or snowy weather.

abilities.name: Earworm
abilities.description: Opponents may get its tune stuck in their heads and lose focus.

entry: It collects melodies carried on the winter winds and hums them back, slightly off-key, until it gets them just right.

name: Mixipod

abilities.name: Curated Vibes
abilities.description: Reads the room. Changes its next move to suit the mood of the battle.

abilities.name: Shuffle
abilities.description: Moves sometimes play in a surprising but perfect order.

entry: It creates elaborate playlists for every occasion and refuses to let anyone else touch the aux cable.

name: Chartitan

abilities.name: Playlist King
abilities.description: Has the right song for every mood. Boosts allies' stats when it switches in.

abilities.name: Bass Drop
abilities.description: Sound moves may cause the opponent to flinch.

entry: It possesses a playlist for every mood, weather and occasion. Its electric speakers can be heard across three valleys.

name: Flixkit

abilities.name: Plot Twist
abilities.description: The first move it uses each battle is a surprise.

abilities.name: Night Vision
abilities.description: Accuracy is not lowered in darkness.

entry: It enjoys collecting stories and films. It hides under blankets during scary scenes but always peeks.

artwork.alt: Flixkit peeking out from a blanket

name: Bingeowl

abilities.name: Autoplay
abilities.description: Automatically uses the same move again unless stopped.

abilities.name: Night Vision
abilities.description: Accuracy is not lowered in darkness.

entry: It never watches just one movie. Its wide eyes reflect the glow of the screen long after the credits roll.

name: Reelflare

abilities.name: One More Movie
abilities.description: Gets stronger each turn the battle goes on past its bedtime.

abilities.name: Spotlight
abilities.description: Fire moves light up the field and lower opponents' evasion.

entry: It continues searching for the perfect film late into the night. Its tail burns like a projector beam.

artwork.alt: Reelflare with a flaming film-reel tail

name: Firawn

abilities.name: Frost Pine
abilities.description: Cannot be frozen. Heals a little in snowy weather.

abilities.name: Ornamental
abilities.description: Its shimmering baubles may confuse attackers.

entry: A young Pokémon whose antlers grow like pine branches. Each winter, frost gathers on them like ornaments.

name: Wrappup

abilities.name: Surprise Gift
abilities.description: Gives a random item to an ally when it enters battle.

abilities.name: Neatly Wrapped
abilities.description: Takes less damage from the first hit.

entry: Nobody knows what is inside its ribbon. It wiggles excitedly whenever someone is about to open a gift.

artwork.alt: Wrappup, a box-shaped Pokémon with a ribbon bow

name: Candlit

abilities.name: Glowing Night
abilities.description: Its light makes allies feel calm and lowers their stress.

abilities.name: Warm Wax
abilities.description: Contact with it may make the attacker sleepy.

entry: It lights up windowsills on long winter nights. Its flame burns brighter in rooms full of laughter.

artwork.alt: Candlit, a small candle Pokémon with a gentle flame

name: Sleighvern

abilities.name: Reindeer Run
abilities.description: Doubles Speed on the first turn. Never misses a delivery.

abilities.name: Aurora Trail
abilities.description: Leaves a shimmering trail that protects allies from critical hits.

entry: It pulls sleighs across the aurora on Christmas Eve. Legends say it can circle the entire region in a single night.

artwork.alt: Sleighvern, an icy dragon with antlers

name: Noelumia

abilities.name: Winterveil
abilities.description: Summons gentle snowfall for five turns when it enters battle.

entry: The guardian of the Winterveil region. Each year it draws a veil of snow over the land so everyone slows down and stays close to the people they love.

name: Harmona

abilities.name: Perfect Harmony
abilities.description: When two voices sing together, every stat rises.

entry: A mythical Pokémon said to appear only on Christmas Day, drawn to homes where two hearts beat in the same rhythm.

artwork.alt: Harmona surrounded by glowing music notes
